opening.argument: Bill Nye opens by saying he is back to answer science questions, and the segment proceeds with explanations of topics such as the internet and gravity. The WIRED title likewise presents the video as answers to questions from Twitter, while the studio setting includes laboratory and science-themed props. These observable features support an educational science-communication purpose. Nothing in the cited material establishes a financial offer or a request to collect viewers' data; the presentation is centered on explaining science.

citations.quote: Bill Nye here, I'm back to answer some of your science questions.
The Internet is a system of computers.
The answer is we know with extraordinary precision what gravity will do.
